title: Site Manifest
description: Composes one site (facility) from the sibling -as-Code repos, like a Terraform root module: which Topology and Allocation facility, which MasterData company and which OrderOrchestration order types belong to it, and which buildings each order type serves. Each repo stays independent; this manifest is the only place that ties them together. It is the input for cross-repo checks (backlog C1) and for a later import into a target WMS. All paths are relative to the root of the repo they belong to.

company.description: Path to the MasterData-as-Code company.yaml whose items this site stores.

buildings.description: Building ids (Topology warehouse.yaml target.building) this order type serves. Its split targets must exist in one of them.

examples.description: Optional directories of illustrative order instances for this order type (OrderOrchestration-as-Code examples/). Their header targets and position item ids are checked like the order type's own rules.
